boundary.name: expiry_one_after_now
boundary.why: now 1999 is strictly before expiry 2000, so the lease is released

boundary.name: expiry_equal_now_untouched
boundary.why: now 2000 equals expiry 2000: the lease is already reclaimable and is left untouched

boundary.name: now_zero
boundary.why: now 0 releases a lease expiring at 1

boundary.name: now_at_clock_limit
boundary.why: now 2**53-1 releases nothing: no expiry can be later

boundary.name: expiry_at_clock_limit
boundary.why: a lease expiring at 2**53-1 is released at 2**53-2

boundary.name: empty_queue
boundary.why: an empty state (next_seq 0) gives an empty receipt

boundary.name: worker_at_grammar_bound
boundary.why: a 64-character worker releases its own lease

boundary.name: attempts_at_max_released
boundary.why: a leased job at attempts 5 returns to ready at attempts 5 (dead-marking stays with the claim)

boundary.name: next_seq_gap_kept
boundary.why: next_seq 9 past the last seq 1 is kept as is

boundary.name: payload_negative_4000_digits
boundary.why: a payload int of -(10**4000 - 1), 4000 digits after the sign, is admitted and kept

boundary.name: payload_depth_at_bound
boundary.why: a payload nested exactly 64 containers deep is admitted and kept

boundary.name: payload_4000_digits
boundary.why: a payload int of 10**4000 - 1 (4000 digits) is admitted and kept

boundary.name: non_ascii_payload
boundary.why: a non-ASCII payload is kept, and the state ids use the non-ASCII-kept queue canon

happy.name: releases_own_unexpired_leases
happy.why: w1's unexpired lease returns to ready; w2's lease, the ready and done jobs are untouched

happy.name: mixed_state
happy.why: w1's leases before expiry are released in seq order (attempts kept, a max-attempts job stays ready); an expired lease, other workers and dead/ready jobs are untouched

happy.name: restart_is_idempotent
happy.why: a second restart of w1 at the same now releases nothing and keeps the state

happy.name: no_lease_empty_receipt
happy.why: a worker holding no lease gets an empty released list and an unchanged state

notes: Closed fixture for the T0347 jobs-restart contract: each happy/boundary row applies its requests in turn to one evolving state and pins every receipt and every committed state computed by the reference restart; malformed rows cover every failure class with a single-locus minimal repair of the state or the request; rollback rows prove a rejected restart leaves the state and request type-exactly unchanged before a valid follow-up commits as pinned. Payload shapes JSON cannot hold and hostile-type variants of every accepted input are derived in the battery, not stored here. Rows are stored one per line.

rollback.name: malformed_then_repaired
rollback.why: a rejected now -1 leaves the state and request unchanged; now 0 releases

rollback.name: corrupt_then_repaired
rollback.why: a rejected corrupt state (priority 10) leaves both unchanged; the repaired state releases
